projects.title: On-chain SVG collections
projects.summary: Mint SVG art that lives on Terp, not a server.
projects.description: Open the SVG UI to make a collection or mint.

projects.title: DAO-DAO
projects.summary: Governance apps on Terp — proposals, voting modules, treasuries.
projects.description: DAO-DAO deployment for Terp Network governance: proposals, voting, and multi-sig treasuries.

projects.summary: Prove a secret without showing it. Toy demo.
projects.description: Your browser makes a proof. Terp checks it. The word never leaves your device.

projects.title: IBC inventory
projects.summary: See which other chains Terp talks to, and fund relayer gas.
projects.description: Live IBC clients and channels. Optional deposits to keep relayers funded.

projects.title: Snapshots & install
projects.summary: Install terpd and skip genesis with a snapshot.
projects.description: Copy-paste installer plus the latest chain-state packs.

projects.title: Community bounties
projects.summary: Cross-chain coordination for open work — multi-chain payouts without single-chain lock-in.
projects.description: Fund tasks in native or IBC assets, attract builders across Cosmos, settle when acceptance criteria land on-chain. Surface reserved at bounties.terp.network.

projects.title: Permissionless.Money
projects.summary: Sister site: art mints and ZK demos.
projects.description: permissionless.money — fractals, minting, and the ZK hub.

projects.title: Penumbra
projects.summary: Private trading and staking: a DEX with encrypted balances and swaps.
projects.description: A DEX where balances, swaps and LP positions are encrypted on-chain, and every block clears at one uniform price. Assets arrive over IBC, for example USDC from Injective or Noble.

projects.title: REStake
projects.description: Let a validator compound your staking rewards for you: an Authz grant lets it send Delegate transactions to itself and nothing else. You can also claim and compound rewards yourself, one at a time or in bulk.

projects.title: Psychedex
projects.summary: The open encyclopedia of altered states.
projects.description: An open-access knowledge platform documenting altered states of consciousness: their phenomenology, risks, and how to reduce harm. Contributions are welcome; people review everything before it is published.
